component.name: LinuxSCP
component.summary: WinSCP-inspired dual-pane file transfer client for the Linux desktop

description.p: LinuxSCP is a modern dual-pane file transfer and remote file management client built specifically for Linux desktop environments.

ul.li: Commander dual-pane file manager layout with independent local and remote panes
Secure SSH / SFTP and atomic SCP file transfer protocols
Strict host-key verification with persistent fingerprint store
Linux Secret Service keyring integration (no plaintext credentials)
Direct application launching through Open With (XDG standard)
Integrated terminal emulator discovery and launching
Remote file editing with conflict detection and automated change syncing

description.p: First public release of LinuxSCP featuring dual-pane file manager, SFTP, SCP, and Secret Service integration.
